title: A solo session with no parent and no cs-build tag may take the batch-runner hat for its own merge
why: The merge role file has no form for a solo session that the owner started (follow-up of step merge-role-allow).
note: Pick taken by the coordinator, no page item (16:32 CST Nov 7): option C.
